targetQueries: eco friendly tube packaging buyer brief
buyerInputs: For cosmetic packaging: product type, jar or bottle dimensions, set structure, insert or tray need, finish direction, sales channel and artwork status.
For paper packaging: package format, product fit, paper or board direction, print coverage, handle or insert need, quantity direction and target market.
For paper tubes: product diameter, height, weight, tube size, cap structure, liner need, print or finish direction and quantity direction.
For all three routes: buyers should send product photos, reference packaging, artwork files if available, destination market and document questions for project-specific review.
Commercial and compliance details should stay project-specific and document-based; do not assume public MOQ, price, lead time or destination-market compliance from a public page.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: A URL or generic product page title with no clear sourcing task.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: A page that immediately says what a buyer should prepare before RFQ: dimensions, structure, material, finish, channel and artwork.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Only lists cosmetic boxes or jars.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Separates jar/bottle/set fit, insert, finish and retail display review.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Treats paper bags, cartons and paper boxes as one broad category.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Routes buyers by bag, carton, sleeve, paper box, handle, insert and print coverage needs.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Only mentions paper tubes as a product.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: Asks for diameter, height, cap style, liner, product fit and finish direction before quote.

decisionMatrix.weakBrief: Makes fixed MOQ, delivery, compliance or certification promises.
decisionMatrix.strongerBrief: States that MOQ, timing, price, documents and compliance are reviewed per project.
